quests.title: A Mysterious Loss

dialogue.t: That's great. Now, let me think... While I can't remember the details, I was wandering around the Thousand Winds Temple earlier...
But as I was running back, I encountered a large group Electro Slimes. I got careless and took a few hits from them, and the box fell out...
Now, I did manage to grab it back, but... I wound up losing it again in my haste.
Still, since the box was touched by those Electro Slimes, it should have some elemental traces on it.
In any case, try following the trail of Electro traces and see what you can find.
Once you've found the box, bring it back to me.
Well... <color=#00E1FFFF>you can also come back and look for me if you really can't find it</color>.
I'll give it a bit more thought. Maybe I'll remember something...

dialogue.sit: Bit hard to search without leads, don't you think?

dialogue.t: Um, alright, one moment. Let me try to remember...
No, nothing comes to mind. There's nothing special about the box, either...

dialogue.sit: Then if I may ask you something...

dialogue.t: Sure. What would you like to know?
Oh, this is terrible. I'm finished for sure...
Gah! Staying here was just too boring, what with the weird looks the sisters give me and all, so I decided to get out, get some fresh air...
But just as I left the city, thinking to go to the Thousand Winds Temple for a stroll... all these meteorites started raining down from the sky.
There was no way I was staying out there, so I ran back into the city... And that's when I realized that I left a box behind...
Given all the chaos out there, I didn't dare to go out to look for it, either.
And, well... I'm Fatui. If I were to make any sudden moves, I'd be suspected of doing something untoward for sure...
Bah, enough nonsense. Could you help me look for that thing?
Our transactions have been quite amiable so far, and I plan to continue doing good business with you...
What? Come now, there was nothing suspicious about the stories I told you...
Well, how about it? Will you help me out, or won't you?
What? Did you need something else?

dialogue.sit: It's a little hard to search without any clues, you know...

dialogue.t: Um, alright, one moment. Let me try to remember...
No, nothing comes to mind. There's nothing special about the box, either...

dialogue.sit: Then if I may ask you something...

dialogue.t: Sure. What would you like to know?

dialogue.sit: What were you doing out there?

dialogue.t: Oh, come on. What's with that look of suspicion?
I just went out for a stroll, really! I legged it back here the moment those meteorites started falling.
Well, whatever. Go out there and have a look. <color=#00E1FFFF>Come back and look for me if you really can't find it</color>.
I'll give it a bit more thought. Maybe I'll remember something...
That's, uh, none of your business. Just a few odds and ends...
Come on! Don't look at me like that. I'm not some kind of villain!
Fatui this, Fatui that... So all of us are the bad guys now? What sort of logic is that?
Well, whatever. Go out there and have a look. <color=#00E1FFFF>Come back and look for me if you really can't find it</color>.
I'll give it a bit more thought. Maybe I'll remember something...

dialogue.sit: What happened while you were running back here?

dialogue.t: While I was running back? Hmm, let's see... No, I can't recall any details.
Ah, yes! I did encounter a large group of Electro Slimes near the <color=#00E1FFFF>Thousand Winds Temple</color> on the way back. They gave me a few hard knocks, causing the box to fall out!
Now, I did manage to grab it back, but... I wound up losing it again in my haste.
Still, since the box was touched by those Electro Slimes, it should have some <color=#00E1FFFF>elemental traces</color> on it.
In any case, try following the trail of Electro traces and see what you can find.
Once you've found the box, bring it back to me.
That's all I can remember. Find me that box, and quickly.
If you can't, well... then I'm done for...
Have you found that box?
You... actually managed to find it! Phew... That's good... That's good.
Uh, fine... Fine, I get it. Out with it, then. What do you want to know this time?

dialogue.sit: So, what do you know about the meteorites?

dialogue.t: The meteorites... Well, not that I don't want to tell you, but I have no clue either.
All I do is stand here in Mondstadt, unable to leave or move. What do I know?
But my gut feeling tells me that those meteorites don't bode well...
I'd stay out of this one if I were you. It can only mean trouble.

dialogue.sit: What about the other Fatui in the city?

dialogue.t: Oh, them? They're probably spinning their wheels here, just like me.
*sigh* I wonder when these days will finally end...

quests.description: Many meteorites have landed outside the city of Mondstadt, wreaking havoc everywhere. Viktor appears to have lost something important, and is talking to himself, flummoxed…
